mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected recycling old cells with making the oxygen-carrying protein in new ones.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing the skin cells was straightforward but felt less like a decision because it was the only gameplay action left.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the recovered iron to travel in blood carried by proteins rather than as metal fragments.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: both pairings followed the goals and picture descriptions. The offered compatibility hints also made the choices clear.

continue.text: I might continue for another chapter to see more connections between body processes, though the short, guided choices leave limited room to figure things out myself.
